description: Find code in this repository. Handles both exact terms (identifiers, error strings, constants) and plain-language descriptions of behaviour in the same call, and returns ranked snippets with file paths and line ranges. Prefer this over grepping and reading whole files: it costs one call instead of guessing at the author's wording.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 5, at most 50).

min_score.description: Drop hits scoring below this (0–1). 0 is no closer than unrelated text in this repository, 1 is every query term found literally; scores fall with rank, so this keeps the top results. Default: no filter.

path.description: Optional subdirectory (relative to the repo) to limit results to, e.g. 'src/embed'.

query.description: What you are looking for: an identifier, an error message, or a description of the behaviour.

name: search
